title: Typical polynomial cutoff bound
statement: For an integer $n\ge 2$, define $K_n$ to be the floor of $\frac n2+\frac n2\sqrt{\frac{2\log(48n)}{n}}$. Then $K_n\le \frac n2+2\sqrt{n\log n}$.
hypotheses_covered: $K_n$ is the floor of $\frac n2+\frac n2\sqrt{\frac{2\log(48n)}{n}}$
